integrity: The claim uses the verified published existence of the double-decomposition family and established cyclic-cover theorems. The enclosed code checks finite arithmetic but does not constitute an external proof of the geometric construction.
scientific_limitations: Only normal complex quintic surfaces with exactly seventeen A2 cusps and two independent weight-twelve cusp-code words intersecting in seven positions; no uniqueness, explicit equations, fundamental-group claim, or complete-canonical-map degree.
title: Canonical character profile of ninefold covers of the seventeen-cusp quintic family
